Le secret du Gâteau Volcan : Moelleux et irrésistible ! 🌋🍫. 1.La base : Battre les œufs avec le sucre et la vanille jusqu’à ce que le mélange blanchisse. 2.Les liquides : Ajouter l’huile tout en continuant de battre, puis verser le lait. 3.Le secret de la texture : Incorporer la farine (environ 300g) petit à petit. Attention : la quantité peut varier selon la qualité de votre farine (certaines absorbent plus que d’autres !). 4.La touche finale : Ajouter le cacao et la levure chimique en même temps que la farine. 5.	Le montage : Verser la pâte dans un moule de 27 cm de diamètre, puis déposer délicatement au centre la crème pâtissière maison. 6.	La cuisson : Enfourner à 180°C pendant 40 minutes. Allumer uniquement le bas au début, puis le haut en fin de cuisson pour dorer. 7.	La déco : Une touche de zeste de citron et du chocolat râpé pour le contraste des saveurs. 🍋🍫 Bon appétit ! ❤️ #GâteauVolcan #CakeChocolat #PatisserieMaison #RecetteFacile

Molten Chocolate Lava Cake  Ingredients: - 1/2 cup unsalted butter - 6oz semi-sweet or bittersweet chocolate, chopped - 2 large eggs - 2 large egg yolks - 1 tsp vanilla extract - 1/4 cup sugar - 1/4 tsp salt - 2 tbsp flour - 1 tsp espresso powder Bake at 450 F for 8-10 minutes in ramekins Makes 4-6 servings (depends on ramekin size) Instructions: Grease your ramekins well and dust  them with a little flour or cocoa powder. Melt the butter and  chopped chocolate together until  completely smooth over a double boiler. Or you can do this in the microwave in  short intervals, stirring between each one. In a separate bowl, whisk together  the eggs, egg yolks, sugar, vanilla, and  salt. Whisk until everything is smooth  and slightly thicker and lighter in color. The extra egg yolks help give the lava  cake a richer, more custardy center. Add the flour and espresso powder into chocolate mixture, and mix just until  combined. The espresso powder isn’t there to  make it taste like coffee—it just helps  enhance the chocolate flavor.  Slowly pour the melted chocolate mixture  into the egg mixture and whisk until  smooth, but make sure not to overmix. Divide the batter evenly between  four to six ramekins, depending on  their size. Bake at 450°F for about 8 to 10 minutes. The edges should be set, but the centers  should still look slightly soft and jiggly. And this is where you really don’t want  to overbake them. Let them rest for a minute, then carefully  flip them onto a plate. #chocolate #cake #dessert #easyrecipe #easydessert

Cokelat pekat dan mint segar berpadu dalam mousse gunung meletus yang mewah tanpa oven. Bahan simpel, hasil elegan—cocok buat ide frozen dessert atau camilan cantik di rumah. Simak resepnya dan tag sahabatmu yang wajib cobain juga! 🍫 --- Volcano Mint Choco Mousse Cake ❄️🌋 (Kue Mousse Cokelat Mint Gunung Meletus Beku) 🍰 Bahan A – Mousse Cokelat Mint Cream cheese: 250 gram Gula pasir halus: 30 gram Whipping cream cair (bisa pakai merek Anchor/Elle & Vire): 150 ml Gelatin bubuk: 10 gram (rendam dulu dengan 3 sdm air dingin, biarkan mengembang) Susu UHT hangat: 80 ml Cokelat chip atau dark compound chocolate cincang: 40 gram Sirup mint (bisa pakai sirup daun mint botolan atau pasta mint): 50 ml 🍫 Bahan B – Dekorasi Whipping cream cair: 30 ml Dark chocolate: 20 gram Ceri segar atau kalengan: 4 buah --- 👩‍🍳 Langkah Pembuatan: 1. Campurkan cream cheese dan gula pasir dalam mangkuk, aduk menggunakan whisk atau mixer kecepatan rendah hingga lembut dan halus. Tambahkan whipping cream, aduk hingga tercampur rata. 2. Panaskan susu hangat, lalu masukkan gelatin yang sudah direndam, aduk hingga larut sempurna. Tambahkan cokelat dan sirup mint, aduk rata hingga cokelat mencair. 3. Tuang campuran gelatin ke adonan cream cheese, aduk rata perlahan hingga semua tercampur halus. Tuang ke dalam cetakan silikon berbentuk bulat atau setengah bola. Simpan dalam freezer selama 6 jam atau hingga benar-benar beku. 4. Ganache: Lelehkan dark chocolate dan whipping cream secara terpisah di microwave selama 30 detik, lalu campurkan keduanya dan aduk hingga mengkilap. 5. Keluarkan mousse dari cetakan, tuang ganache hangat di atasnya untuk efek meleleh seperti gunung berapi, lalu hias dengan ceri di atasnya. Sajikan beku untuk sensasi segar-lumer di mulut! #ResepKue #Dessert #Mousse #MousseTanpaOven #FrozenDessert #KueMint #KueEnak #KueAntiGagal #IdeCemilan

Chocolate Volcano Cake Ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (70%) 150g butter 150g sugar 3 eggs 100g flour 25g cocoa powder 8g vanilla sugar 2g salt 3-4g baking powder (optional, for a fluffier texture) Preparation: Melting Chocolate and Butter Break the chocolate into pieces, mix it with butter, and melt over a double boiler or in the microwave (in short 20-second intervals, stirring in between). Making the Batter In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with sugar and vanilla sugar until light and fluffy. Pour in the melted chocolate and butter mixture, then stir well. Sift in the flour, cocoa powder, salt, and baking powder (if using). Mix gently. Baking Preheat the oven to 170°C. Pour the batter into a 20cm round cake tin lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20-25 minutes. The cake should remain slightly moist inside (check with a toothpick—it should come out slightly sticky). Cooling and Serving Let the cake cool completely in the tin. Optionally, dust with powdered sugar or serve with a scoop of ice cream and caramel. Enjoy! 🍫🎂 #cake #easyrecipe #cupcakes #foodlover #brownies #chocolate #dessert #foodtok #fyp #cookie
